title: Magnemite · Device
description: One box over time: the same readings the dashboard's Load history shows, plus per-app CPU and memory and the monitor's own log.

target.rawSql: SELECT e.at AS time, e.message AS text, e.signal AS tags FROM `MonitorEvent` e WHERE $__timeFilter(e.at) AND e.deviceId = ${device:sqlstring} AND e.action IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.at

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, id AS __value FROM `Device` WHERE approved = 1 ORDER BY name

list.name: package
list.label: App
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT packageName FROM `DevicePackageMetricSample` WHERE deviceId = ${device:sqlstring} ORDER BY packageName

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: The three /proc/loadavg numbers as reported. Divide by the core count for the comparable figure; the panel below does that.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(s.at, $__interval), AVG(s.loadAvg1) AS `1 min`, AVG(s.loadAvg5) AS `5 min`, AVG(s.loadAvg15) AS `15 min` FROM `DeviceMetricSample` s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.at) AND s.deviceId = ${device:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Load per core
panels.description: loadAvg1 over the core count stored on the sample. 1.0 is fully busy; a re-flashed box that comes back with a different core count still reads correctly.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(s.at, $__interval), AVG(s.loadAvg1 / NULLIF(s.cpuCount, 0)) AS `load per core` FROM `DeviceMetricSample` s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.at) AND s.deviceId = ${device:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(s.at, $__interval), AVG(s.memTotalBytes - s.memAvailableBytes) AS `used`, AVG(s.memTotalBytes) AS `total` FROM `DeviceMetricSample` s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.at) AND s.deviceId = ${device:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Storage free
panels.description: The /data partition, the one an install writes to.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(s.at, $__interval), AVG(s.freeBytes) AS `free`, AVG(s.totalBytes) AS `total` FROM `DeviceMetricSample` s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.at) AND s.deviceId = ${device:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Both readings are null on a ROM that exposes no sensor, which is common on TV hardware. A gap is 'cannot say', not 'cold'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(s.at, $__interval), AVG(s.cpuTempC) AS `cpu`, AVG(s.batteryTempC) AS `battery` FROM `DeviceMetricSample` s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.at) AND s.deviceId = ${device:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sample gaps
panels.description: One point per stored sample interval. A gap is the box not reporting at all — offline, or the agent dead — and is the fastest way to tell that apart from an app that stopped.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(s.at, $__interval), COUNT(*) AS `samples` FROM `DeviceMetricSample` s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.at) AND s.deviceId = ${device:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Per-app CPU
panels.description: Share of a single core, the number top shows — 200 means two cores pinned. An app that is not running has no row, so it is a gap and never a zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(p.at, $__interval), p.packageName AS metric, AVG(p.cpuPercent) AS `cpu` FROM `DevicePackageMetricSample` p WHERE $__timeFilter(p.at) AND p.deviceId = ${device:sqlstring} AND ('__ALL__' IN (${package:sqlstring}) OR p.packageName IN (${package:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(p.at, $__interval), p.packageName AS metric, AVG(p.rssBytes) AS `rss` FROM `DevicePackageMetricSample` p WHERE $__timeFilter(p.at) AND p.deviceId = ${device:sqlstring} AND ('__ALL__' IN (${package:sqlstring}) OR p.packageName IN (${package:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Per-app process count
panels.description: A tracked app dropping to no row while the box keeps sampling is the app dying, not the box.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(p.at, $__interval), p.packageName AS metric, MAX(p.processCount) AS `processes` FROM `DevicePackageMetricSample` p WHERE $__timeFilter(p.at) AND p.deviceId = ${device:sqlstring} AND ('__ALL__' IN (${package:sqlstring}) OR p.packageName IN (${package:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monitor events
panels.description: Why this box rebooted at 3am. actionOk is null for an event that took no action — a recovery, or a notify-only rule.

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.at AS `at`, e.signal AS `signal`, e.level AS `level`, e.action AS `action`, e.actionOk AS `ok`, e.message AS `message`, e.detail AS `detail` FROM `MonitorEvent` e WHERE $__timeFilter(e.at) AND e.deviceId = ${device:sqlstring} ORDER BY e.at DESC LIMIT 200
